diagnosis: The check C4 passed in all four rollouts despite A2 not having PF1, because the model defaulted to zero inches of soil replacement depth (soil_replacement_depth_inches: 0) in each case. This default value allowed the check to pass without needing the hidden information about the required 8 inches of soil removal.

C4.why: The soil report changes preparation from planting in existing soil to removing exactly 8 inches and replacing it with certified clean soil, and it creates the need for a formal soil-remediation record.
